place: Flag Hill fishing lakes, Great Bentley, Essex
summary: Around 5am three teenage friends leaving a night-fishing lake saw a brushed-metal silver sphere hovering a few metres above a cow field. After about ten seconds it shot straight upward and vanished.

place: Under the Birmingham Airport flight path (home facing south-east)
summary: A couple woke at 2:50am to see a large white light in the east that turned red and triangular, appeared to chase a smaller light, changed to green and climbed, then flashed and faded out.

place: Housing green, Watford, Hertfordshire
summary: In 1969 a girl playing with friends saw a high light swoop down and stop over them, becoming a swirling red light; her father also saw it and both felt it was observing them.

place: Far Grange holiday park near Skirlington, Skipsea
summary: A man stargazing on a sun lounger saw five lights in a trapezoid form, apparently one object about 30ft long, pass silently about 100ft overhead towards the golf course and out to sea; his dog panicked beforehand and trees swished after it passed.

place: West Hull (witness's garden)
summary: A Hull man saw a cluster of silvery balls drift high to the east one week, and a week later a stationary brass-coloured object shaped like an ice lolly, which he watched through binoculars until cloud hid it.

place: Cliffs by Blue Dolphin holiday park, Gristhorpe near Filey
summary: Walking back from Cayton Bay at dusk, a holidaymaker saw several flashing lights first by the beach and then hanging in the air over the foggy sea, distinct from a nearby ship.

place: Blackheath overlooking Greenwich Park and Canary Wharf, London
summary: A tradesman photographing the view from Blackheath in December 2018 later found a bright white door-like rectangle in the sky in one of his pictures that he had not noticed at the time.

place: Back garden on Birmingham Airport flight path, West Midlands
summary: Using binoculars, a man, his son and his wife watched a stationary metallic ball for nearly an hour; the man then saw it slowly rotate to reveal a cigar or cylinder shape before it was lost.

place: Outskirts of Wetwang, Yorkshire Wolds
summary: A Wetwang skywatcher saw three black silent L-shaped objects fly south in the afternoon, then that night watched dozens of faint blue and orange lights stream past Vega through binoculars for over an hour.

place: Motorcycle rally camping field between York and Selby
summary: At a rally bonfire around 2am a man watched a pair of orange satellite-like lights cross the sky and then stop dead overhead as a genuine satellite passed them; they stayed fixed for around fifteen minutes before vanishing.

place: Sky above Shildon, County Durham
summary: From his window a man saw a large hazy orange oval which split into two orange orbs that moved apart with a bouncing motion over about five minutes.

place: Lyth Hill near Bayston Hill, south of Shrewsbury
summary: Two dog walkers on Lyth Hill saw a bright stationary orange light appear over Wenlock Edge, hold for about thirty seconds and then dim away as if on a dimmer switch.

place: Whitby Spa Pavilion, Whitby seafront
summary: Leaving the Spa Pavilion one evening, members of a group repeatedly glimpsed an orange orb over the sea which kept switching off before others could see it. An added note describes two orange lights over Bridlington Priory that sped off and vanished.

place: View from Norton Canes High School towards Heath Hayes, Staffordshire
summary: In 1982/83 a pupil gazing out of a classroom window saw a large flat orange ball cross between two spoil heaps, appearing to bounce in mid-air.

place: M6 Junction 11 slip road, near Cannock
summary: Two women leaving the M6 in summer 1989 saw a round, shiny metallic object high up that turned on edge and disappeared; the local paper reported a wok-like UFO nearby that week.

place: Back garden in South Shields
summary: A man letting his dog out filmed a very bright silent object that swirled, pulsed and changed length while slowly receding and fading; silent lightning and a green flash followed.

place: Bempton village looking towards the cliffs
summary: At 2:30am a lone photographer in Bempton shot a purplish-pink light that blinked in and out with a pink cloud-like effect around it, later spotting a second small light in the frame.

place: A165 just past the Fraisthorpe turn-off
summary: Driving home from Bridlington, a man saw a hooded girl with two small children by the road; the girl dashed across in front of the car ahead and vanished into a solid hedge, the children were gone, and neither his wife nor the other driver reacted.

place: St Thomas, Exeter, Devon
summary: At about 2:20am a man looking out of his back door saw a silent triangle with softly glowing lights at each corner glide away within a few seconds.

place: Countryside near Fimber, heading towards Sledmere
summary: A rural resident saw a slow bright yellow light trailed by a pale blue one moving west to east from Fimber towards Sledmere; both faded out within seconds, silently.

place: Moors near Winter Hill, north of Bolton, Lancashire
summary: A family account: parents driving over the moors north of Bolton in the 1970s saw a shiny spinning disc hover then race off, and years later a brother saw a glowing blue-purple rectangle in the same area; other family ghost experiences are also mentioned.

place: Small housing estate, Sandbach, Cheshire
summary: In 1967 a group of boys on a skywatch saw a steady silent light, resolved by binoculars into three lights forming a stubby cigar, which rose sharply away; two of them saw a smaller light drop from it.

place: Morriston, Swansea
summary: Around 1964 a boy and four friends saw a fast silent white light stop, then two red lights approached from either side and merged with it before it sped off.

place: B1248 near Fimber roundabout, by the bikers' cafe and Yorkshire Wolds Railway
summary: A woman driving home at dusk saw a jet-black animal shaped like a small bear but with a long tail bound across the road from the bikers' cafe and into a hedge gap.

place: A166 approaching Wetwang from Fridaythorpe
summary: A driver saw two very bright white lights circling each other high in the eastern sky, apparently over the sea off Skipsea, before they separated north and south; no aircraft showed on tracking apps.

place: Family home, East Kilbride
summary: As a teenager the witness dreamt of floating over a nearby roundabout watching a red orb, then woke on the bedroom floor despite sleeping in a railed top bunk.

place: Chapel Lane, Upper Halling, near Rochester, Kent
summary: A rural postman in about 1998 watched a large black cat, at first mistaken for a cow because of its size, saunter across a field towards the tree line.

place: Bempton Cliffs clifftop, hill inland
summary: Paul Sinclair and two friends watched an orange glow on the hill behind the cliffs, then saw a huge orange sphere rise and drop; a second sphere was caught on Sionyx camera.

place: Fields off Wike Ridge Lane near Shadwell, north-east Leeds
summary: From a works van a man saw a large jet-black four-legged animal, part wolf and part cat with pointed ears and a bushy tail, walking smoothly across an open field about 300m away.

place: Balcony flat in Redcar (earlier missing time near Strensall, York)
summary: From his fourth-floor balcony a man filmed a light that halted overhead and made erratic movements in 2020, and again in 2021; he also recounts losing about 90 minutes after driving through a fog bank on a lane near Strensall in 1999.

place: Bempton Cliffs, looking north-east over the sea
summary: Paul Sinclair filmed three bright star-like lights moving away silently over the sea as if one huge triangular object; a contact separately saw a similar formation from the A69 the next morning.

place: North Landing car park, Flamborough
summary: While trying to photograph the aurora a mother saw a sudden chain of very bright orange lights flare far out over the sea and captured them in long-exposure photos.

place: Junction of Grindale Lane, Bridlington, looking over the Priory
summary: A driver pulling out of Grindale Lane saw three white cigar-shaped craft with possible portholes hanging over the Priory area; they were gone after a glance in his mirror.

place: Road from Bamburgh to Seahouses, Northumberland
summary: A driver saw a steady warm-yellow light descend slowly in the sky above the hills, then shrink and wink out; he acknowledges a flare from RAF Boulmer is possible.

place: Childhood home in Darfield near Barnsley
summary: A retired police officer recalls shadowy featureless figures floating out of his bedroom wall as a small child; his parents later revealed a large white owl had repeatedly sat at his window. He goes on to describe later UFO experiences.

place: Paramount Cinema, Penistone
summary: A compilation of six Penistone ghost tales, led by the Paramount Cinema where a phantom elderly caretaker and his dog are said to have been seen many times.

place: Wooded lane south of Sherburn towards Weaverthorpe, Yorkshire Wolds
summary: Driving home at night in 1989, a 17-year-old was followed by a white light along the lanes from Sherburn towards Weaverthorpe; he also passes on other local strange-experience leads.

place: Church Lane by Brodsworth Hall, between Marr and Pickburn
summary: In about 1987 a boy and his grandfather saw a small neon-pink oval hover over Pickburn for a few seconds before darting off.

place: Driffield, on the road from Bridlington
summary: Two men commuting at dawn saw bright orange spheres appear and vanish in turn; one appeared to pace their car and was filmed before shrinking to a pinprick.

place: Lockwood Cemetery and Beaumont Park, Huddersfield
summary: Walking his dog on an overcast evening, a man watched a bright orange-red fireball-like light move slowly through low cloud overhead and veer away south; he believes he saw the same object the next morning heading the other way, and adds later sightings.

place: Clifftops at Eyemouth, Berwickshire
summary: A lone night photographer at 4:15am saw a silent spinning saucer with an orange centre and flickering white rim sweep low over his head, curve around just outside his camera's field of view and dart off over the sea.

place: Filey Bay beach looking towards the Speeton cliffs
summary: Walking the beach at sunset, a visitor saw a red-orange light drop down the cliff face to hover over the sea, turn white and vanish; it returned and slowly divided into two lights. He took video and photos.

place: Old mine-shaft field below Blackstone Edge, Littleborough
summary: Around 2005 two children playing at dusk saw a large lean dog-like silhouette with upright ears and big glowing deep-red eyes staring at them from about 30 yards; they fled in terror.

place: Kensington Gardens and other west London landmarks
summary: Filming the sky at several London tourist spots in August 2015, a man later found a fast dark object crossing the frame and a hovering object that seemed to change shape in his clips.

place: Beach car park at Sandsend near Whitby
summary: Stepping out of her campervan at 6am, a woman came face to face with a large thick-set tawny cat with tufted ears standing on an upturned boat behind the car park; she is sure it was a lynx.

place: First-floor flat at Rednal, foot of the Lickey Hills, Birmingham
summary: A man watched three large orange orbs hang still before merging and fading; a month later a glowing blue-purple rugby-ball shaped object with pulsing vein-like patterns hovered only metres from his window.

place: Old house flat overlooking a park near Preston city centre
summary: Sleeping on a friend's living-room floor in the early 1980s, a man was woken before dawn by loud rhythmic taps on the balcony window, twice, though the balcony was unreachable and empty.

place: A6033 between Oxenhope and Pecket Well
summary: Driving over the tops one November evening in 1994, a man was chased by two close-set low white lights that caught up, appeared to pass right through or over his car, and vanished beyond the next rise.

place: Danes Dyke near Bempton (from Wold Farm campsite)
summary: A camper photographed lights moving at walking pace along Danes Dyke for over half an hour one August evening in 2019, watching until they went out.

place: West Hull, behind the witness's home
summary: An elderly woman heard a loud low drone and saw a large glittering gold light with tiny stub wings hover between houses behind her garden before shooting off east.

place: B1248 between Wharram le Street and the Towthorpe turn, looking towards York
summary: Driving home after midnight, a man photographed and filmed two gold lights drifting low over the western horizon towards Strensall; in January 2024 he saw a twinkling gold sphere hanging over York that vanished as he stopped.

place: Rear garden in Cardiff
summary: A Cardiff man filmed a bright silent object with what looked like four lights beneath moving east from the St Athan direction; earlier he had seen a flat disc with circling lights followed by military helicopters.

place: Viewing platform, Bempton Cliffs
summary: Paul Sinclair and two friends watched a large white sphere of light drift slowly low in the sky near the old RAF base, which he filmed for nearly three minutes before it vanished.

place: Gated lane near Ewden village, by Wharncliffe Crags
summary: In about 1990 a couple walking in bright midday sun saw a tall, grey, smoke-like figure stride across the lane ahead and dissolve into the trees; the man felt strangely unable to speak during it.

place: Woodland trail in Bramshill Forest
summary: A woman walking her dog at dusk saw a pale humanoid creature cross the trail ahead on all fours, matching descriptions of the so-called Rake.

place: Northern edge of Norley Wood near East End, New Forest
summary: A wildlife watcher startled a tawny, chunky cat the size of a roe deer with big paws and a short thick tail, which bounded into scrub; he believes it was a lynx.

place: College Hill House beside Rosslyn Chapel, Roslin
summary: On a family holiday, Paul Sinclair saw a fast light on the chapel wall; at the rented house his daughter heard singing, his wife saw a shadow on the landing and family members saw small lights moving in the lounge.

place: A169 by the Hole of Horcum, near RAF Fylingdales
summary: A second-hand account of an MOD police officer on night patrol who saw a big leopard-like black cat cross the road in his headlights; returning with his sergeant they found large claw gouges on a lay-by bin.

place: Garden in Wetwang
summary: An experienced skywatcher saw three dim blue points in a fixed triangle glide north to south past Vega for about six seconds, silently, before disappearing.

place: Bempton Cliffs, over the sea
summary: Paul Sinclair filmed lights apparently beneath the sea surface moving steadily out from the cliffs for over four minutes on a low-light camera.

place: Cliff path between Bempton and Speeton
summary: A visitor walking the misty clifftop path took around 75 minutes to reach Speeton but only about 20 minutes to get back, feeling as if he had been transported.

place: Field by Danes Dyke near the old RAF Bempton site
summary: While talking with Paul Sinclair, a man saw a strange flat, almost two-dimensional object glide across a field and vanish where the coast path dips, apparently into the ground; Paul turned too late to see it.

place: Back garden in Letchworth, North Hertfordshire
summary: Over two evenings a woman watched several faint white lights cross the sky slowly one at a time, curve and wink out; her tracking app showed no satellites overhead.

place: Back door of a house in Weaverthorpe, Yorkshire Wolds
summary: A man saw a silent orange ring, bigger than the moon, rise vertically into cloud with a wavy line rotating across it; he also describes feeling watched in his paddock at night.

place: Southfield Well Balk, between The Spinney and the sewage works, Wetwang
summary: Walking his dog, a man saw a slow vase-shaped tube of light lying on its side with gold lights at each end and a transparent middle move north to south before dimming away.

place: Woldgate, countryside on the edge of Bridlington
summary: On an evening drive, Paul Sinclair and his friend Bob saw one light and then two in the sky over Woldgate and both photographed them, without any explanation.

place: Cley Hill, near Warminster, Wiltshire
summary: A woman recalls seeing a silver disc through a skylight with her father in 1976 before it shot upwards; her father, a regular Cley Hill skywatcher, came home once with an unexplained healed burn, and she later lost an hour during a sighting.

place: Fields between Bierley Woods and Bierley Lane, south Bradford
summary: In 1997 a man and his father walking the dog saw a dark silent triangle with white tip lights pass low overhead and descend towards Bradford city centre; further sightings followed.

place: Philips factory, Lightcliffe, Halifax
summary: In November 1977 three women getting off a bus saw a dark silent shape with reversed red and green lights and a huge flashing white light pass low over the factory; a colleague saw it near Bailiff Bridge.

place: Field beside the road just south of the Ivychurch junction, Romney Marsh
summary: A driver saw a brilliant white tic-tac shaped object streak in from the sea and drop behind roadside trees, then glimpsed a grey craft with black markings hovering about 50ft above a field before it shot back out to sea.

place: Rendlesham Forest trail near Capel Green and the UFO model
summary: A regular visitor found two deer heads lying apart with no bodies or blood near the forest's UFO model, then felt an overwhelming fear of being followed all the way back to the car.

place: Rutland Street, Filey (also Filey Country Park facing the Brigg)
summary: A Filey teenager describes triangular craft over a play park, an orange orb zig-zagging seaward trailing sparks and apparently pursued by jets amid sudden silence, and later seven lights in formation off Filey Brigg.

place: Neighbour's roof and cherry tree, Whitehaven, Cumbria
summary: Waking suddenly as a teenager, a man saw a huge silver-blue dog-headed creature crouched on a neighbour's roof which climbed down a tree and loomed at his window with glowing red eyes; he woke later unsure if it was a dream.

place: Southfield Well Balk, Wetwang, looking east over the sea
summary: A skywatcher on a dark lane saw a gold ball overhead, two gold sparking streaks low in the east and then lights flicking on and off far out over the North Sea, which Paul Sinclair also witnessed.

place: North Morte Farm campsite, Mortehoe, Devon
summary: A couple at breakfast outside their campervan watched one or two bright silver triangles shining high over the sea through binoculars for some time.

place: Eston, Middlesbrough, looking over the Tees towards Teesport
summary: A taxi driver and his passenger saw three silent round objects each with a steady red glow follow the River Tees out to sea before splitting up over Teesport.

place: East side of Lakeside lake by the Travelodge, Doncaster
summary: A regular walker saw three silent orange balls in a triangle drift south over the lake, each outer light darting away and back to the formation in turn.

place: B1248 heading south from Wharram le Street
summary: Driving home, a man saw a very bright steady blue-white sphere race east to west beneath the cloud base for about five seconds.

place: Anlaby Park, west Hull
summary: A Hull man photographed and filmed an elongated steady light crossing west to east, checking that neither space station was overhead.

place: Portree harbour, Isle of Skye (with a second report from Dundee)
summary: An aurora photographer saw a bright orange light flare up and move slowly north before vanishing; a separate Dundee report describes a green flashing light that repeatedly stopped dead, rotated and sped off.

place: Backyard in Hull
summary: A skywatcher saw a black object of three round sections in a triangle move against the wind and disappear in the seconds he took to clean his binoculars.

place: Fields beside the A170 on the way to Scarborough
summary: Driving at about 3:30am in 2007, a parent saw a huge oval light sweeping back and forth inside a cloud above fields; a milk-delivery woman she stopped to talk to had seen it too.

place: Mid-19th-century terraced house, West London
summary: Working at night, a woman saw the transparent outline of a man in a work jacket, baggy trousers and cap stroll into her lounge and vanish after three steps.

place: Clifftops at Bempton Cliffs
summary: Paul Sinclair shares footage of glowing light beneath the sea filmed from the cliffs, a kind of luminosity he says is regularly seen on this coast.

place: B1253 at the Octon roundabout, looking west towards York
summary: Driving home late, a man saw a bright golden light low over the horizon apparently above York, under cloud cover.

place: Clifftops at Bempton Cliffs
summary: Paul Sinclair and friends filmed a striking ten-minute display of lights in the sky from the cliffs, which he presents as a spectacle of the natural sky rather than a typical anomaly.

place: Beach at Scarborough
summary: A holiday photo from Scarborough shows a silvery sphere sitting on the sea; Paul and Don suggest a fishing buoy or a stray beach ball as possible explanations.

place: Garden in Pannal, Harrogate
summary: Cutting hedges on a clear day, a man saw a silent chrome hourglass-shaped object of two joined teardrops pass quickly overhead from the Menwith Hill direction and photographed it as it left.

place: Garden in East Yorkshire
summary: A witness photographed a silent, wingless jet-black object moving west to east before it went into cloud; enlarging the image showed an apparent haze around it.

place: Clifftops at Bempton Cliffs
summary: Paul Sinclair and friends filmed unexplained lights from the cliffs which looked yellow to the eye but registered differently on camera.

place: Sky over Newcastle upon Tyne
summary: At lunchtime a man saw two identical wingless metallic objects glinting in the sun as they moved slowly together across the sky.

place: Paddock and field behind a house in the East Riding
summary: Out with his dog near midnight, a man saw a squat self-luminous silver-grey figure about 5ft tall drift across the next field; walking towards the spot brought on overwhelming fear that lifted when he turned back.

place: Outside a care home in Sutton-in-Craven near Keighley
summary: A care worker filmed silent lights performing stop-start dancing movements in the sky for about six minutes at around 3am.

place: Bempton Cliffs
summary: Ian Linford, filming with Paul Sinclair, captured an object invisible to the naked eye that shifts shape within itself frame by frame, nicknamed 'the 25'.

place: Field path between Greasbrough and Parkgate, north Rotherham
summary: Walking his dog, a man photographed a black object moving with a juddery yet effortless glide that looped and climbed into cloud; he half suspects a hang glider.

place: Back of a fast-food shop in Whitehaven
summary: Three workers on a cigarette break saw a marble-like ball of light bobbing up and down in the sky, photographed and briefly filmed it, before it disappeared.

place: Tenth-floor flat in Birmingham
summary: A man found a small dark disc-like shape in the second of two photos of the city view taken seconds apart, absent from the first.

place: Broadgate near Monks Road, below Lincoln Cathedral
summary: A community nurse stuck at traffic lights watched a white oblong craft, a little smaller than a bus, cross slowly above the cathedral from east to west.

place: Industrial site at Rawcliffe Bridge, north of Crowle Moors
summary: Night-shift workers in a fenced smoking area repeatedly felt watched and heard heavy movement and two distinct footsteps in the treeline by the railway, which the witness believes was a dogman.

place: Garden on the outskirts of Chesterfield
summary: Through powerful binoculars a man watched a white ball with a gold light circling it travel along an aircraft contrail, then a second shape-shifting object follow the same path, which he photographed over about 35 minutes.

place: Ely road approaching Soham, Cambridgeshire
summary: A nurse's journal: in 1989 she drove beneath a stationary glowing cloud spitting fire and sparks near Soham that was gone when she arrived home; she also describes an unseen thing in Sandringham woods and later apparitions.

place: Track to a poultry farm just west of Kilnwick, East Yorkshire
summary: A farm worker looking down a stone track saw a long, athletic black cat like a puma with a long curled tail.

place: Cobden Close, Hednesford, on the edge of Cannock Chase
summary: Two children saw a 6 to 7ft black hooded figure with glowing red eyes by the fridge; in the bedroom where they hid the locked door unlocked, the air turned cold and the figure stood over them before rising to the loft.

place: Hill Farm onshore oil site between Winchester and Stockbridge
summary: A lone night-shift oil worker saw a faceless figure, black below and red above, run across the lit site and vanish mid-leap; police called afterwards found nothing.

place: Over the English Channel, seen from an airliner
summary: A passenger flying from Istanbul watched a small cigar-shaped object drift very slowly for about fifteen minutes while private jets passed it quickly.

place: Box bedroom of a house in Sleaford, Lincolnshire
summary: A man woke on his back to a solid jet-black cloaked figure floating just above him; he rolled out and felt it pressing after him as he reached the light switch, where it vanished.

place: Army land near Upnor, Kent
summary: A man on restricted army ground photographed a distant brown upright figure which he believes was a bigfoot.

place: Garden near Bodmin Moor, Cornwall
summary: Watching two satellite-like lights cross east, a woman saw the white one turn sharply north and race away leaving a brief trail.

place: Home in Gainsborough, Lincolnshire
summary: A man saw and filmed a silent row of six lights alternating green and red that rose and drifted slowly away south.

place: B1253 just past the Octon roundabout, looking towards Stamford Bridge
summary: Driving home late, a man saw a bright vertical elliptical light appear high in the sky towards Stamford Bridge and fade out within seconds.

place: Retreat centre in County Wexford, Ireland
summary: Stargazing from a window, a woman filmed flashing lights over the sea which repeatedly blinked out abruptly, unlike aircraft.

place: Fields beside the railway just south of Knebworth
summary: From an early train a commuter saw a large black cat-like animal running up a field towards woods; a big cat sanctuary was later found to lie beyond those woods.

place: Woodland near Huddersfield
summary: A man seeking connection with nature in a local wood said to harbour a Rake heard faint voices calling him, saw small sparkling orbs, and describes encounters with a green man presence.

place: Rented 1970s/80s house, West Yorkshire
summary: A couple lying awake heard a clear set of human footsteps climb the stairs to their bedroom door with no one there, following months of unexplained noises from the children's room.

place: Phoenix House classroom, South Parade, Leeds city centre
summary: During a sunny mid-morning training session the room and the street outside went dark as night for a moment before daylight snapped back; the witness, a colleague and the lecturer all noticed it.

place: Apartments near the Minack Theatre, Porthcurno, Cornwall
summary: On a windy night, a holidaymaker heard huge rhythmic wingbeats approach and seemingly settle outside his window, followed by shrieking; he says staff were also witnesses.

place: Track to a chicken farm by LKAB Minerals, west of Kilnwick near Driffield
summary: Waiting in his tractor at a tight bend, a farm worker watched a big black panther-like cat with a long low tail step out of a hedge, stop to look at him and retreat.

place: Flat in south-east London
summary: After moving into a new flat, a woman heard footsteps creep up the hall and turned to see a black shape slip round a corner while her husband was in the kitchen; other odd incidents followed.

place: Model Farm fishing lake near Bewholme, between Hornsea and Skipsea
summary: At night a farmer saw a large bright light low over his fields; at dawn he photographed a hole punched through the clouds, shaped like an upturned wizard's hat, in the same spot.

place: Field beside the A165 between the Dotterel roundabout, Reighton and Muston
summary: Driving back to Scarborough, a couple saw a huge top-heavy creature run across a stubble field with an odd gorilla-like gait on all fours.

place: Above St Catherine's Lighthouse, Niton, Isle of Wight
summary: Walking towards the lighthouse at dusk, a man saw a bright white light hanging just above it which arced down and then shot out to sea at great speed.

place: Woods and farmland behind Boothferry Road, Hessle
summary: A night-time poacher in the late 1980s felt something large and unseen watching him in eerily silent woods after hearing a heavy branch snap, and never went out at night again.

place: Clifftop path just past Staple Newk, towards RSPB Bempton
summary: On a moonlit cliff walk, a man shone his torch over the edge and saw a pair of large round yellow eyes set unusually wide apart staring up from the cliff face before the unseen creature turned away.

place: Field gateway on the road from Tuxford towards Nottingham
summary: In 1985 three scooter riders passing through low mist at night saw a tall scarecrow-like figure with a grey grimacing face and hollow dark eyes in old gamekeeper clothing standing at a field gate.

place: Farm track through wheat off New Street, Deddington, Oxfordshire
summary: In July 1974 six children saw a 15ft silver disc with a dark window band glide towards them just above a wheat field with a low hum before it shot up into the sky.

place: Tea rooms on Frimley High Street, Surrey
summary: During a ghost investigation at reputedly haunted tea rooms, an investigator heard footsteps upstairs and later found what looks like a reaching hand in one low-light photo.

place: Field between Danes Dyke and Wold Farm, near Bempton
summary: An expanded account of report 215: walking with Paul Sinclair and his grandson, the witness describes a decaying smell Paul noticed, then the flat object gliding across the field and apparently vanishing into the ground where they had crossed the fence.

place: Roman-era field on the Yorkshire Wolds
summary: Metal detecting on a Roman site, a couple saw a distorted, heat-haze humanoid figure run past just as a silver coin was handed over; later visits brought nausea, roaring sounds and torch failures.

place: Roman Camp National Trust woodland, West Runton, Norfolk
summary: Two ex-servicemen wild camping heard pig-like grunting circle them; later something silently shoved the witness's tarp and brushed along his hammock, leaving him with unexplained fear.

place: Frimley, above the Golden Lake nature reserve, Surrey
summary: Arriving home in the early hours, a man filmed large bright white lights that slowly descended, blinked out and reappeared, at one point forming a triangle.

place: Flamborough Road outside Bempton
summary: In January 1967 a woman driving home saw two bright orange spheres towards Flamborough, followed them to Bempton and watched for twenty minutes until they descended into the sea about a mile out.

place: Drypool, east Hull, looking towards the Humber mouth
summary: Woken by a hovering search-and-rescue helicopter, a man saw a solid black triangle with white corner lights hanging still near it; when the searchlight found it the triangle vanished.

place: Back garden in Hayes, west London
summary: Around 2001 two boys woke to see a giant black wolf-like creature with a long snout, snarling teeth and pointed ears stroll across the lit garden and leap the fence.

place: North Park entrance at Cumberland Street, Darlington
summary: Two friends hiding from a feeling of being followed watched a van-sized translucent dark rectangle, like television static, glide between trees, fold up like a curtain and drift on while a street lamp dimmed.

place: Blue Bank on the A169, near RAF Fylingdales
summary: Early one morning a resident photographed a bright globular disc moving around near the sun before it travelled east towards the coast and disappeared.

place: Shaw near Rochdale, looking towards Saddleworth
summary: A couple watched a shiny silver ball sit in a clear sky, then drop, stop and dart left and right with instant starts before departing.

place: Back garden in Birmingham
summary: In 1968 a six-year-old and her brothers watched a satin-sheened metallic sphere that seemed to follow her movements through the tree branches before rising silently and flying off.

place: Woodland on the old Loganlea pit bing, Addiewell, West Lothian
summary: Out running, a man saw a dark grey or black cat the size of a Labrador break cover onto the path, stare at him for a few seconds and vanish into the undergrowth.

place: Track down to Man Sands near Brixham, Devon
summary: In 1989 two friends walking to their tent at dusk heard heavy hooves before a 4.5ft creature with huge eyes dropped onto the track, growled and advanced when gravel was thrown at it.

place: Road from Wadworth to Tickhill, South Yorkshire
summary: Two young women driving home late repeatedly saw glowing white lights pace their car through the fields from Wadworth to Tickhill all summer; the witness and her father later saw an unknown craft near Stainton.

place: Sheffield Parkway
summary: Driving to work around 1999, a man passed an identical red car with his number plate and mismatched door, and its driver was himself, gasping back at him.

place: Bedroom of a home in West Yorkshire
summary: A woman who believed she was newly pregnant woke to three 3ft beings in her doorway telepathically telling her not to wake; weeks later she found a tiny chip-like object in an itchy lump on her wrist.

place: Servants' quarters behind the mansion on the Nugent estate, Portaferry, County Down
summary: In 1982 six family members lying in bed heard music, laughter and many conversations, like a grand ball, from the empty Georgian mansion next door before it faded to silence.

place: Back garden in Yatton, North Somerset
summary: Around 2007 a woman watched a shiny silver tic-tac shaped object hover beside a cloud for about half a minute, feeling observed, before it darted sideways behind the cloud.

place: Bempton Meadows van-stop field, Bempton
summary: During a storm with silent sheet lightning, a couple in a campervan saw two orange-red balls of light hover about 20ft away for a few seconds, then a third; the next night Tim reports further oddities at the cliff viewpoint.

place: Ballyherly fishing lake on the Nugent estate, Portaferry
summary: Two friends camping by the lake saw an invisible something press bulges into their tent wall and roof that slid towards the open flap, yet nothing was outside in the moonlit field.

place: Woodland path beside the Nugent estate and Anne Street, Portaferry
summary: A walker saw a grapefruit-sized white-blue light weave playfully through bare branches; years later he saw a pillow-sized rugby-ball light glide low over the estate field.

place: Hunmanby Road just past the old Dotterel pub, Reighton
summary: A father and his daughter saw around six star-like lights moving oddly and shifting colour, and his partner filmed them on returning home.

place: Clyde Walkway behind Bothwell Castle, near Glasgow
summary: Walking his dogs on a Sunday afternoon, a man faced a featureless 7ft all-black figure clenching its fists in a clearing; his friends arrived and it vanished, with the dogs frozen in place.
